image_location_description: Upper left of torso (viewer’s left), arm angled inward toward saber grip

steps.title: Upper arm core
steps.description: Sandwich 1x2 W brick between two 1x2 W plates (top/btm).

steps.title: Shape shoulder & elbow ends
steps.description: Add four 1x1 W plates: 2 at shoulder, 2 at inner elbow.

steps.title: Elbow spacer + bend
steps.description: Add 1x1 W brick at inner end; attach 2x2 corner W plate to turn inward.

steps.title: Elbow thickness
steps.description: Stack two 1x1 W plates on the corner to read as an elbow joint.

steps.title: Forearm bricks
steps.description: Extend inward with two 1x2 W bricks in a straight line.

steps.title: Forearm caps
steps.description: Add two 1x4 W plates (top and bottom) to box in the forearm.

steps.title: Forearm crease
steps.description: Add two 1x1 W plates mid-forearm for articulated look.

steps.title: Wrist offset base
steps.description: Add 1x2 W jumper at wrist; add 1x1 W plate under wrist end.

steps.title: Cuff + skin hand
steps.description: Add two 1x1 W plates as cuff; attach Tan 1x1 headlight as hand.
